items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: we would sit there until 8:00, 9:00 and 10:00 in the morning, listening to Art Tatum play.

ctx.x: Oh, it scared everybody. And then, the same breakfast dances, they would tie up every once in a while, and at one of the breakfast dances, Art would be there and Earl would be there. So everybody wanted to hear the two of them play, but very seldom did they play from each other. Art would play at the drop of a hat.
